symptoms: Oval to elongate cinnamon-brown powdery pustules on both leaf surfaces
Pustules erupt through epidermis releasing reddish-brown urediniospores
Pustules turn blackish-brown later in the season
risk_factors: Cool to moderate temperatures (16-24°C) with high relative humidity
Windborne spores carried north from southern growing regions
recommended_actions: Fungicide treatment is rarely required unless high rust pressure hits before tasseling
